problem: Replacement-module identity suppressed all guest initializers/finalizers even while guest exports were retained and resolved by dependent modules. A retained guest allocator can therefore be called before its private heap state is initialized.

policy.replacement_with_retained_defined_visibl: Preserve guest init/fini and arrays independent of symbol type: functions, exported mutable data and TLS can all depend on guest-owned initialization.
policy.replacement_without_retained_defined_vis: Continue suppressing guest lifecycle for no-export, local, internal/hidden, undefined and absolute-only symbols.
policy.host_companion: Keep host companion dependencies, independent host lifecycle, guest-first symbol routing and module dependency ordering unchanged.

synthetic_regressions.uninitialized_allocator: Provider returns NULL until its own initializer runs; dependent constructor requests exactly 48 bytes, and a separate host companion verifies valid storage.
synthetic_regressions.initialized_exported_data: Provider initializer writes 42 to exported STT_OBJECT data; dependent constructor verifies 42 through the retained guest export.

event_legend.B: allocator verified NULL before guest init
event_legend.D: dependent constructor verified initialized exported data

synthetic_regressions.unsupported_ifunc: STT_GNU_IFUNC remains an explicit input-reader rejection; two negative fixtures verify that contract.
